findings.title: Authority is a denylist: any new event type is AI-allowed by default (I2 fails open at type level)

findings.observed: Computed by reading: AI-allowed set = NOTE_ADDED, CLAIM_ADDED, EVIDENCE_ADDED, PROPOSAL_SUBMITTED (implicit complement); HUMAN_ONLY_EVENTS is typed readonly EventType[], which does not force exhaustiveness.

findings.title: Schema accepts ids, timestamps and hashes as arbitrary text; `at` is validated only by Date.parse; ids are plain string
findings.claim: exists event: parseStoredEvent(e) succeeds with at in {"1","12"}, id/claimId of 20000 chars, hash/prevHash not 64-hex; Date.parse("1") is valid in V8
findings.witness: node -e "console.log(Date.parse('1'),Date.parse('12'))"; then parseStoredEvent({v:1,seq:0,id:'x',at:'1',prevHash:'p',hash:'h',type:'PROJECT_CREATED',actor:{kind:'human'},payload:{projectId:'p',title:'t'}}) returns an event (only chain verification rejects it)
findings.observed: Date.parse("1") = 978303600000, Date.parse("12") = 1007161200000 (machine local time), so reducer.ts:171 accepts non-ISO strings. Parse step of the second half not run. schema.ts:62-63 hash/prevHash are z.string() with no hex/length check. No branded ids: a claimId can be passed where a noteId is expected.
findings.fix: schema: at = z.iso.datetime(); hash/prevHash = z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/); ids = bounded SAFE_ID regex; in types.ts brand ClaimId/NoteId/ProposalId.
